videos.why: Jordan's real face spinning a ball at centre court from frame 0, his price on a tag and the sale value held back; a famous name with a surprise most viewers don't know (a losing team still made him about 11 times his money).
strengths: Famous face recognisable with the sound off
The title asks and holds the payoff back
The payoff (B, 10.9x) answers the hook in one line
risks: Pure celebrity topic, not the thing in your hand
The TV-money mechanism is told in words more than in figures

Real logo and the CEO's real face
